title: Normalized rational Verdier comparison for one coefficient embedding
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell\ne D.p$, and a separated finite-type $D.k$-scheme $X$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Use the raw rational constructible categories and canonical coefficient functors [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], and the normalized rational Verdier data and comparison predicate [def-sf-rational-verdier-data]. Let $E,L$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, $i:E\to L$ a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding, $w_E,w_L$ coherent integral dualizing data [def-sf-coherent-integral-dualizing-datum], and $A,B$ any normalized rational Verdier data for them whose signed symmetries are natural in both variables (without naturality the symmetry, and with it the biduality map, is fixed only on literal K-flat pairs, so the biduality square can fail by a sign). There exists a scalar comparison $e=(\overline u,\overline\beta)$ from $A$ to $B$ satisfying ExtensionProperties: its components are the localizations of the canonical integral $u$ and $\beta$, and it preserves completed evaluation and the actual biduality. No unit or composition coherence is asserted.

proof.text:
For $E\subset L$ let $S=\mathcal O_L$ and $T=T_{S/R}$. The exact functor $T$, the dualizing comparison $u:T\omega_{X,R}\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_{X,S}$ and the natural duality comparison $\beta_K:TD_RK\xrightarrow{\sim}D_STK$, with their inverses, are supplied by [lem-coef-integral-finite-extension]. Define the rational comparison to be $Q_S(\beta_K)$. Its source and target are exactly those stated: [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] defines $-\otimes_E L$ by $K\mapsto TK$ and $f\otimes a\mapsto T(f)\otimes a$, $a\in E\subset L$, and step 2 defines $D_E,D_L$ on the same representatives. For $f:K\to M$ integral naturality reads $D_S(Tf)\beta_M=\beta_KT(D_Rf)$; its image multiplied by $a$ is the equation for $f\otimes a$, and additivity gives rational naturality. The localized inverse remains inverse. That lemma's evaluation compatibility uses ordinary tensors and the strong comparison $c^\circ_{A,B}:TA\otimes^L_{\widehat S_X}TB\xrightarrow{\sim}T(A\otimes^L_{\widehat R_X}B)$; put $c_{A,B}=T(\chi_{A,B})\,c^\circ_{A,B}\,\chi_{TA,TB}^{-1}$ with $\chi$ of [lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion] over $R$ and $S$. With $\mathrm{ev}$ as in step 5, naturality of $\chi$ turns the two supplied compatibilities into
$$\mathrm{ev}_{S,TK}\circ(\beta_K\widehat\otimes1_{TK})=u\circ T(\mathrm{ev}_{R,K})\circ c_{D_RK,K},$$
$$\beta_{D_RK}\circ T(\delta_{R,K})=D_S(\beta_K)\circ\delta_{S,TK},$$
from $TD_RK\widehat\otimes_S^LTK$ to $\omega_{X,S}$ and from $TK$ to $D_STD_RK$. For the rational scalar extension $\overline T$ write $\overline u,\overline c,\overline\beta$ for the images. Applying $Q_S$ gives, with the tensor and evaluation convention of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom],
$$\mathrm{ev}_{L,\overline TK}\circ(\overline\beta_K\otimes1_{\overline TK})=\overline u\circ\overline T(\mathrm{ev}_{E,K})\circ\overline c_{D_EK,K},$$
$$\overline\beta_{D_EK}\circ\overline T(\delta_{E,K})=D_L(\overline\beta_K)\circ\delta_{L,\overline TK},$$
the required rational evaluation and biduality compatibilities, since $Q_S$ preserves composites and $\overline TQ_R=Q_ST$ on these integral arrows.

theorem extension_exists
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (i : E →ₐ[Padic l] L)
    (wE : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl E)
    (wL : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl L)
    (A : Datum D l hl X E wE) (B : Datum D l hl X L wL)
    (hA : ∀ (K M K' M' : IntegralHom.Derived.{u, u} X
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X))
      (f : K ⟶ K') (g : M ⟶ M'),
      A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫ (A.symmetry.swap K' M').hom =
        (A.symmetry.swap K M).hom ≫ A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom g f))
    (hB : ∀ (K M K' M' : IntegralHom.Derived.{u, u} X
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X))
      (f : K ⟶ K') (g : M ⟶ M'),
      B.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫ (B.symmetry.swap K' M').hom =
        (B.symmetry.swap K M).hom ≫ B.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom g f)) :
    ∃ e : Extension D l hl X E L i wE wL A B,
      ExtensionProperties D l hl X E L i wE wL A B e
